how_to_apply: Fill the Google Form via the provided link before the interview.
Download the soft copy of the Brief Profile of the Candidate, fill in details in MS-Word, and bring it on the date of the walk-in interview.
Report at the venue with all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and passport size photograph.
